benchmark_metadata.name: AEGIS-ML Dual-Telemetry Controlled Correlation Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.disclaimer: Measures correlation engine software correctness on controlled synthetic fixtures. Does not represent real-world detection accuracy.

scenarios.description: Endpoint process and network flow share verified socket_id on same host.
Isolated file read without network socket; must not infer exfiltration.
Concurrent archiving (PID 3300) and web browsing (PID 8800); must not attribute web socket to 7z.
Multiple distinct processes executing simultaneously on same host.
PID 1234 reused by different process instance; must reject process lineage match.
Matching PID 2048 on two separate machines; must remain separate incidents.
Missing socket binding; must be tagged as hypothesis with missing_evidence.
Network connection processed before process launch; monotonically correlates.
Coincident timestamp across distinct entities; must stay in separate incidents.
Authorized robocopy backup archiving; must record alternative benign explanation.
